finding.expected: Keep the diagnostic attach-only and bounded, but bind explicit identity only to a deterministic current-PDP surface: use the canonical observed-URL identity where available and otherwise only tightly scoped current-product identity attributes/meta associated with the bounded PDP root, never arbitrary product-card IDs elsewhere in the document. Reject generic/home/category/unrelated routes even when they contain a matching product card. Detect CAPTCHA/security/login state through bounded direct challenge/login selectors or equivalent explicit page-state markers independent of the first 500 characters of the candidate root. Add deterministic regressions for an unrelated shop page containing the target product card and for a challenge/login overlay while a valid-looking PDP main remains underneath. Do not add navigation, raw-HTML capture, broad body dumping, retry, or a second parser/identity authority.
finding.issue: The attach-only diagnostic's current-page safety gate is not fully fail-closed. DIAGNOSTIC_SCRIPT collects explicit_product_ids from any [data-product-id] anywhere in the document, while _validate_payload accepts any shop.tiktok.com URL that merely avoids a small path blacklist. A generic or unrelated TikTok Shop page can therefore pass exact-target admission if a product card happens to expose the authorized source ID. The same script derives blocked/login state only from document.title plus the first 500 characters of the selected root's innerText, so a CAPTCHA/security/login overlay outside that root can be missed while an underlying PDP-like main subtree remains present. This leaves AC3/AC4 incomplete and means AC6 does not yet prove the required exact-page and challenge fail-closed behavior.
